posts.text:
🇮🇳 Distributor & Reseller Partners Wanted | SafeGuard air 

The way we monitor our health has evolved. It's time we started monitoring the air we breathe too.

At SafeGuard air, a brand of Mythri InnovoTech Solutions Pvt Ltd, we have designed and developed a Made in India range of smart air quality solutions, and we're looking for distributors, channel partners, and resellers to help us bring them to more people across India and global markets.

Our product portfolio includes:
🌿 SafeGuard air Sense – A portable, carry-anywhere air quality monitor that helps you understand the air around you—whether you're in your bedroom, kitchen, office, living room, car, or travelling. It delivers real-time air quality insights and empowers users to take preventive action when pollution levels rise.

🌬️ SafeGuard air Ultra – A personal air purifier designed to provide cleaner air wherever life takes you.

These products are especially valuable for:
✔️ People with allergies
✔️ Individuals with asthma or other respiratory conditions
✔️ Families with children and seniors
✔️ Health-conscious consumers who want to make informed decisions about the air they breathe

We believe everyone deserves access to clean air awareness, and together we can make that vision a reality.

If you are a distributor, reseller, retailer, healthcare supplier, electronics dealer, or B2B channel partner, we'd love to connect and explore opportunities to grow together.

📩 Reach out to us and become a part of the SafeGuard air journey.

Know What You Breathe.

Wellness devices taught us to track our sleep, stress, and activity.

But one important question remains:

Who is monitoring our health?

Consumers today are becoming more health-conscious than ever. They want more than wellness scores — they want meaningful health insights that can help them make better decisions.

What if a wearable could combine:
✅ Wellness insights
✅ Medical-grade monitoring
✅ Early health indications
✅ Continuous vital tracking

That is the future we believe in.

We are building a new category where wellness meets clinically meaningful health monitoring. A wearable that focuses not only on how you feel, but also on what your body is trying to tell you.

The future of wearables is not just about tracking steps.

It's about helping people make better health decisions.

Would you trust a wearable that combines wellness and medical-grade monitoring?

We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback.

Finding the right intern to work directly under a CEO has been one of the toughest challenges for us.

We are not looking for someone to simply complete tasks. We are looking for individuals who want to understand how startups are built, how products are developed, how teams make decisions, how funding works, and how companies scale from an idea to reality.

Working alongside a founder or CEO offers exposure that many traditional roles cannot provide. You witness strategy, execution, failures, customer conversations, product decisions, and growth—all in real time.

What I often observe is that many students and young professionals prioritize convenience, fixed roles, or short-term comfort over learning opportunities. The early years of a career are not only about salaries and titles; they are about building experience, taking ownership, and learning faster than others.

India has immense young talent. The opportunity is there, startups are creating it, but sometimes these opportunities are overlooked during the most important learning phase.

To aspiring interns: don't just ask, "What will I get?" Ask, "What will I become?"

The right learning environment can change the trajectory of your entire career.

Wellness wearables have helped millions of people understand their sleep, stress, and activity levels. That is a great first step.

But one question remains:

Are we only tracking wellness, or are we truly monitoring health?

What if clinical-grade health parameters could be combined with wellness insights?

What if a single wearable could help users understand both their lifestyle and their vital health information?

That is exactly what we are trying to build.

We believe the future of wearables is not choosing between wellness and healthcare — it is bringing both together.

Would you trust a wearable that combines wellness insights with clinically meaningful health data?

We would love to hear your constructive feedback. What else would you expect from the next generation of wearable health technology?

What if you could finally see the air you breathe?

Every day, we check the weather, monitor our health, and track our fitness—but most of us never know the quality of the air around us.

That is about to change.

After months of innovation, testing, and validation, we are proud to announce that SafeGuard air Sense has successfully achieved CE, FCC, and Battery certifications, bringing us one step closer to our public launch.

Designed and developed by Mythri InnovoTech Solutions Pvt Ltd under the SafeGuard air brand, air Sense is built to help people understand their environment and make informed decisions about the air they breathe.

This is not just another device.

It is our commitment to making air quality awareness accessible, portable, and actionable.

The air around you is constantly changing.

Soon, you'll finally know what you're breathing.
